assumptions.span_link: Half-reaches correspond to the GIS scenario base spans19/23/27m, not measured roads

not_resolved: Wind area, drag, gusts and operating threshold
Footpad stiffness, contact area and bearing
Horizontal friction, sliding, torsion and anchorage
